environment: Full locked Hermes Native agent-automation suite (649 library + 15 protocol + 3 launcher), all-target cargo check, Windows debug desktop build, rustfmt and diff checks. No live Hermes Gateway or installed Hermes app was used.
notes: The usage_window card parses the pinned snake_case/camelCase suggestion shape, offers the first recommended model, and submits the original failed prompt once only after a matching session model mutation reports applied. Non-applied/deferred receipts and target mismatches do not retry. The same action also exposes the Nous portal when provider identity permits, and a valid future resets_at can use the existing bounded scheduled retry. Hermes credit opt-in and an in-app billing surface are still unsupported. Live Gateway, packaged Windows and source-paired acceptance remain open; PAR-0064 remains partial.
